PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana

Income Support

PM Kisan Samman Nidhi provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments to eligible farmer families across India. The amount is transferred directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts.

Last updated: 2026-09-18

Main Benefit

Eligible farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 each, typically every four months. The amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

Eligibility

  • All land-holding farmer families across India, subject to exclusion criteria
  • Farmer families with cultivable landholding as per state/UT records
  • Excludes institutional landholders
  • Excludes former and present ministers, MPs, MLAs, mayors, and members of local bodies
  • Excludes serving or retired government employees with monthly pension above ₹10,000
  • Excludes income tax payers
  • Excludes professionals like doctors, engineers, lawyers, and chartered accountants

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card of the farmer
  • Bank account details with account number and IFSC code
  • Proof of land ownership or possession as per state/UT norms (land records, pattadar passbook, or similar)
  • Mobile number for OTP verification
  • Self-declaration of eligibility

How to Apply

New farmers can apply through the official PM Kisan portal at pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centres (CSCs). The application requires land ownership details, bank account information, and Aadhaar. Registration is completely free — do not pay any agent or intermediary. After submission, the application is verified by state authorities before benefits are disbursed.

How to Check Status

Farmers can check their payment status, registration details, and instalment history on the official PM Kisan portal at pmkisan.gov.in using their registration number, mobile number, or Aadhaar number. The 'Beneficiary Status' section shows whether instalments have been credited and any issues with the account.

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is eligible for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi?

All land-holding farmer families across India are potentially eligible, subject to exclusion criteria. Excluded categories include institutional landholders, former and present ministers, MPs, MLAs, mayors, members of local bodies, serving or retired government employees with monthly pension above ₹10,000, professionals like doctors and engineers, and income tax payers. Always check the latest official guidelines for the complete list.

How much money do farmers receive under PM Kisan?

Eligible farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 each. The instalments are typically transferred every four months, though exact dates are notified by the government.

How can I check my PM Kisan payment status?

You can check your payment status on the official PM Kisan portal at pmkisan.gov.in using your registration number, mobile number, or Aadhaar number. The portal shows instalment history and current status.

How do I apply for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi?

New farmers can apply through the official PM Kisan portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or through Common Service Centres (CSCs). The application requires land ownership details, bank account information, and Aadhaar. Registration is free — do not pay any agent or intermediary.

What documents are needed for PM Kisan registration?

Typically required documents include proof of land ownership or possession (as per state/UT norms), Aadhaar card, bank account details with passbook or cancelled cheque, and mobile number for OTP verification. Exact document requirements may vary by state.

Is PM Kisan available to tenant farmers or sharecroppers?

Eligibility for tenant farmers and sharecroppers depends on state/UT-specific guidelines and whether they can provide acceptable proof of cultivation. Some states have mechanisms to include them, but this varies. Check with your state agriculture department or the official PM Kisan portal for current rules.

What should I do if my PM Kisan payment is not received?

First, check your status on pmkisan.gov.in to see if the instalment was credited. If the status shows success but money is not in your account, verify your bank account details and Aadhaar linkage. If there's a discrepancy, contact your state nodal officer or use the grievance mechanism on the official portal.

Can I receive PM Kisan benefits if I am an income tax payer?

No. As per the scheme guidelines, income tax payers are generally excluded from PM Kisan benefits. This is one of the key exclusion criteria. If your tax status changes, you should update your details accordingly.
